{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu_prefix_carry #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] p,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] g,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] carry
);
    localparam LEVELS = (WIDTH > 1) ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 0;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] pp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] gg [0:LEVELS];
    assign pp[0] = p;
    assign gg[0] = g;
    genvar level, bit_index;
    generate
        for (level = 0; level < LEVELS; level = level + 1) begin: prefix_level
            localparam integer DIST = (1 << level);
            for (bit_index = 0; bit_index < WIDTH; bit_index = bit_index + 1) begin: prefix_bit
                if ((bit_index % (2*DIST)) >= DIST) begin: combine
                    localparam integer ANCHOR = (bit_index / (2*DIST)) * (2*DIST) + DIST - 1;
                    assign pp[level+1][bit_index] = pp[level][bit_index] & pp[level][ANCHOR];
                    assign gg[level+1][bit_index] = gg[level][bit_index] |
                        (pp[level][bit_index] & gg[level][ANCHOR]);
                end else begin: forward
                    assign pp[level+1][bit_index] = pp[level][bit_index];
                    assign gg[level+1][bit_index] = gg[level][bit_index];
                end
            end
        end
        for (bit_index = 0; bit_index < WIDTH; bit_index = bit_index + 1) begin: carry_output
            if (bit_index == 0) begin: first_bit
                assign carry[bit_index] = 1'b0;
            end else begin: other_bit
                assign carry[bit_index] = gg[LEVELS][bit_index-1];
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_xor = a ^ b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_equal = ~bit_xor;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_and = a & b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bit_or = a | b;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_carry, ab_borrow, ba_borrow;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_value = bit_xor ^ add_carry;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ab_value = bit_xor ^ ab_borrow;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] ba_value = bit_xor ^ ba_borrow;

    pw_alu_prefix_carry #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) add_prefix (
        .p(bit_xor), .g(bit_and), .carry(add_carry)
    );
    pw_alu_prefix_carry #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) ab_prefix (
        .p(bit_equal), .g((~a) & b), .carry(ab_borrow)
    );
    pw_alu_prefix_carry #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) ba_prefix (
        .p(bit_equal), .g(a & (~b)), .carry(ba_borrow)
    );

    wire select_add = (Oper == 3'b000);
    wire select_ab = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire select_ba = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire select_or = (Oper == 3'b011);
    wire select_and = (Oper == 3'b100);
    wire select_xor = (Oper == 3'b101);
    wire select_xnor = (Oper == 3'b110);

    always @* begin
        sum = ({WIDTH{select_add}} & add_value) |
              ({WIDTH{select_ab}} & ab_value) |
              ({WIDTH{select_ba}} & ba_value) |
              ({WIDTH{select_or}} & bit_or) |
              ({WIDTH{select_and}} & bit_and) |
              ({WIDTH{select_xor}} & bit_xor) |
              ({WIDTH{select_xnor}} & bit_equal);
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end

    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );

    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index = 0; index < STAGES-1; index = index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index == 0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths traverse substantial combinational arithmetic and result-selection logic between existing registers. The mapped paths do not uniquely identify source operations, but reducing carry/borrow depth and keeping opcode decoding outside arithmetic propagation directly targets this cone.",
  "rewrite": "Replace inferred arithmetic with three parallel balanced prefix networks: addition, a-minus-b borrow, and b-minus-a borrow. Subtraction uses equality propagation and direct borrow generation, avoiding opcode-controlled operand inversion. All operations share the operand XOR, equality, AND and OR terms. A one-hot masked OR selects the result after arithmetic. The complete sequential pipeline and its named state remain unchanged.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The 16-bit prefix networks have four combine levels, with opcode selection only at the output. This is intended to improve setup WNS over the 7.71 ns baseline by shortening arithmetic propagation. The actual gain is unmeasured; fixed-flow synthesis and STA are required to establish whether WNS improves.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel prefix arithmetic adds explicit propagate/generate wiring but shares subtraction propagation and bitwise intermediates. The balanced topology uses fewer prefix combines than a full all-position doubling network. No registers or cycles are added. Mapped area and electrical compliance have not been measured and must be checked against the 4573.511360 um2 cap.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves unsigned WIDTH-bit modulo arithmetic, the seven opcode functions, and zero for opcode 111. WIDTH and STAGES remain parameterized, including the specified WIDTH=16 and STAGES=2 configuration. All original register names, synchronous reset behavior, latency, unconditional data updates and valid propagation are retained. No initialization or input assumptions are introduced; repeated resets and invalid-cycle data retain their original behavior. Source and mapped equivalence still require execution of the evaluation checks."
}
